rationale: This article chronicles political and environmental opposition to the Gabcikovo-Nagymaros hydroelectric dam and barrage on the Middle Danube. It concerns hydropower infrastructure and river management conflict rather than household or community drinking water or sanitation service access (E07) and examines no domestic water/sanitation access outcome.
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both readings due to wrong water sector/service (E07: hydropower dam and river barrage conflict rather than household or community water or sanitation service access), even though broad institutional/political governance actors (governments, parliament, regime change) are discussed.

evidence_quotes.quote: Movement against the Middle Danube Hydroelectric Dam
Chronicles the history of the Hungarian movement opposed to the Gabcikovo (Bos)-Nagymaros Barrage (the Middle Danube hydroelectric dam)
